ADR-style decisions
Architecture decisions: đủ Context / Decision / Rationale / Trade-off.

ADR-01: Collection

OTel
Context: nhiều service, cần schema chung.
Decision: SDK + Collector.
Trade-off: thêm instrumentation effort.

ADR-02: Transport

Kafka
Context: telemetry burst/backpressure.
Decision: topics by signal type.
Trade-off: operational complexity.

ADR-03: Processing

Flink
Context: cần rolling windows/replay.
Decision: streaming; pandas for lab.
Trade-off: heavier than batch.

ADR-04: Detection

MAD + IF
Context: skewed incident metrics.
Decision: MAD primary, IF confirm.
Trade-off: IF less explainable.

ADR-05: Logs

Drain3
Context: logs structured but dynamic params.
Decision: template mining.
Trade-off: calibration needed.

ADR-06: Storage

Hot + cold
Context: query recent + replay history.
Decision: VM/Loki/S3.
Trade-off: multiple stores.
